name: erp-app
description: ERP development environment with Node.js, MySQL, and Vue 3.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.test: npm test --workspace server && npm test --workspace client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace server && npm run test:coverage --workspace client
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:mocked && npm run e2e:item-management
scripts.e2e:mocked: npm run e2e:business-master && npm run e2e:supplier-management
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run security:audit
scripts.security:check: npm run security:audit && npm run test
